final_text:
Made the app significantly more secure by hardening both server and auth handling.

What I changed:
- Added security headers and disabled `x-powered-by`
- Added request body size limits to reduce abuse
- Strengthened JWT secret handling so weak/missing secrets fail fast
- Tightened cookie handling for auth tokens
- Increased password minimum length and hashing cost
- Improved production-safe DB SSL handling and pool settings
- Reduced error leakage from the global error handler
- Updated env example to reflect safer defaults
- Simplified/updated tests to match the new auth requirements

Validation:
- Ran the test suite successfully

If you want, I can also add rate limiting, CSRF protection, and input sanitization for an additional security layer.
